title: Project Manager
description:
**Role Description** 




 The Project Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Gandhinagar, responsible for overseeing end\-to\-end delivery of client project. This role includes planning project scope, timelines, and resources, coordinating cross\-functional teams, and ensuring milestones are met within budget and quality expectations.
 



  





 The Project Manager will manage stakeholder communication, track risks and dependencies, and facilitate alignment between product, engineering, and client teams. Day\-to\-day tasks involve maintaining project documentation, monitoring progress, driving issue resolution, and ensuring smooth logistics and expediting activities for project deliverables. The role also requires continuous improvement of project processes, support for inspections and quality checks, and proactive reporting on project status to leadership and clients.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong project management skills, including Project Management, planning, scheduling, and stakeholder coordination.
* Experience in expediting and related activities, such as Expeditor responsibilities and Expediting to ensure on\-time delivery of tasks and materials.
* Knowledge of Inspection processes to support quality assurance and compliance across project deliverables.
* Ability to handle Logistics Management, coordinating resources, timelines, and dependencies for smooth project execution.
* Prior experience managing technology or software development projects, ideally in AI, SaaS, or product engineering environments.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross\-functional teams.
* Strong problem\-solving, risk management, and decision\-making abilities in fast\-paced, deadline\-driven settings.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; project management certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) are an advantage.

title: Turbine Lead Project Engineer (M/F)
description:
Your Role
   

  

 As a Turbine Lead Project Engineer, you will lead the mechanical scope of one or several nuclear steam turbine projects.
   

  

 You will be part of a project team and coordinate engineering activities within the design office, in a context of increasing project complexity and fast\-paced changes.
   

  

 You will play a central role in delivering high\-performance mechanical engineering solutions on world\-class equipment.
   

  

 As a Turbine
 **Lead Project Engineer** 
 , you will lead the mechanical scope of one or several nuclear steam turbine projects.
   

  

 You will be part of a project team and coordinate engineering activities within the design office, in a context of increasing project complexity and fast\-paced changes.
   

  

 You will play a central role in delivering high\-performance mechanical engineering solutions on world\-class equipment.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Coordinate engineers and technicians across mechanical design, thermodynamics, and calculations
* Lead engineering activities ensuring quality, on\-time delivery, and budget compliance
* Monitor and report engineering KPIs (schedule, budget, post\-design freeze changes)
* Prepare, review, and validate technical deliverables (reports, calculation notes, drawings)
* Lead and facilitate design reviews
* Manage technical interfaces with:
+ internal disciplines
+ clients
+ suppliers and manufacturing sites
+ erection/site teams

* Support manufacturing and site activities (clarifications, deviations, non\-conformances)
* Contribute to continuous improvement through lessons learned (feedback)
* Ensure nuclear safety requirements are identified and properly monitored
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulations and lifecycle considerations
* Plan and secure ITNS gate reviews
* Apply EHS (Environment, Health \& Safety) standards


**Your Profile**
**Education**
* Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering


**Experience**
* Minimum 5 years in engineering design (energy, oil \& gas, aerospace, or special machinery)


**Your Skills**
* Strong mechanical design and calculation fundamentals
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes and non\-destructive testing
* Ability to manage complex technical interfaces
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear, structured, and high\-quality technical documentation
* High level of autonomy and decision\-making capability
* Structured, rigorous, and results\-oriented


**Languages**
* Fluent English (spoken and written)


**What We Offer**
* An international and dynamic environment, committed to a sustainable future
* A collaborative company culture focused on expertise


**Ready to make an impact?**
 Join a committed team making a difference by delivering cutting\-edge technologies in support of a
 **sustainable nuclear energy future** 
 .
   

  

 Join us and work with global teams to support global customers ! At Arabelle Solutions, we have team members of more than 49 nationalities spread across 16 countries.
   

  

 At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.

title: Senior SAP CX/C4C Consultant
description:
SAP C4C Lead Consultant
 
**Position:** 
 SAP C4C Lead Consultant
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 10\+ Years
 



**Location:** 
 Gandhinagar, Gujarat
 



**Department:** 
 SAP Consulting
 


 About the Role
 
 We are looking for a highly experienced
 **SAP C4C Lead Consultant** 
 with 10\+ years of SAP CRM/CX experience to lead SAP C4C engagements, solution design, implementations, integrations, enhancements, and support projects.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong functional and solutioning expertise in SAP C4C, excellent client\-facing skills, and proven experience in leading consulting teams and delivering complex SAP CX solutions.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Lead end\-to\-end
 **SAP C4C / SAP Cloud for Customer** 
 implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support projects.
* Act as the
 **SAP C4C functional lead and subject matter expert** 
 for client engagements.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP C4C solutions.
* Lead requirement\-gathering workshops, business process discussions, solutioning sessions, and client presentations.
* Design and oversee configuration of SAP C4C across
 **Sales and Service** 
 processes.
* Provide expertise across
 **Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Activities, Sales Quotes, Tickets, Service Requests, Visits, and related CRM processes** 
 .
* Lead solution architecture and functional design for complex business requirements.
* Define integration requirements between SAP C4C and
 **SAP ERP, SAP S/4HANA, and third\-party applications** 
 .
* Work closely with technical consultants and integration teams on APIs, middleware, interfaces, and custom developments.
* Review functional and technical specifications and ensure alignment with the proposed solution.
* Lead
 **SIT, UAT, defect management, cutover, deployment, and post\-go\-live support** 
 activities.
* Identify project risks, dependencies, gaps, and potential solution issues and drive them toward resolution.
* Provide technical and functional guidance to consultants and review their deliverables.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level SAP C4C consultants and contribute to capability development within the team.
* Work closely with project managers, business stakeholders, technical teams, and other SAP functional teams.
* Support effort estimation, solution proposals, RFP/RFI responses, demos, and presales activities.
* Participate in client meetings and independently manage functional discussions with senior stakeholders.
* Ensure project deliverables meet defined quality, timeline, and documentation standards.
* Stay updated with SAP CX roadmap, product innovations, and industry best practices.


 Required Skills \& Experience
 * **10\+ years of overall SAP CRM / SAP CX experience** 
 , with significant hands\-on experience in
 **SAP C4C** 
 .
* Strong experience in
 **SAP C4C implementation, configuration, enhancement, integration, and support** 
 .
* Strong understanding of CRM business processes, particularly
 **Sales and Service** 
 .
* Proven experience in leading SAP C4C projects and functional teams.
* Strong experience in requirements analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
* Experience integrating SAP C4C with
 **SAP ECC/SAP S/4HANA and non\-SAP systems** 
 .
* Strong understanding of SAP C4C integration capabilities and middleware technologies.
* Experience working with senior client stakeholders and leading business discussions.
* Ability to independently analyze complex requirements and provide appropriate solution options.
* Strong experience in preparing and reviewing functional specifications, solution design documents, test scenarios, and project documentation.
* Excellent communication, presentation, analytical, and stakeholder\-management skills.


 Good to Have
 * **SAP C4C / SAP Cloud for Customer certification** 
 .
* Experience with
 **SAP Sales Cloud and SAP Service Cloud** 
 .
* Experience with
 **SAP Cloud Integration / CPI** 
 .
* Knowledge of
 **SAP Cloud Application Studio / PDI** 
 .
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA integration.
* Exposure to SAP CX solutions and broader SAP Customer Experience portfolio.
* Experience in presales, solutioning, estimation, and proposal development.
* Experience working in global implementation environments.
* Agile/Scrum project experience.


 Leadership \& Behavioral Competencies
 * Strong client\-facing and consulting skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management.
* Strong leadership and team\-management capabilities.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a project environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication.
* Strong mentoring and knowledge\-sharing capabilities.


 Key Competencies
 * **SAP C4C \| SAP CRM/CX \| Solution Design \| Functional Leadership \| Sales \& Service \| Integration \| SAP S/4HANA \| Client Management \| Team Leadership \| Presales \| Business Process Analysis \| Project Delivery**
